answer: Each agent must earn its signing key by locking a scarce deposit that is slashed when independent auditors prove the same operator controls supposedly distinct identities. Auditors sample actions unpredictably and compare shared funding paths and coordinated timing; a match triggers a challenge, not an automatic conviction, so coincidence alone does not destroy a deposit. A sybil operator must therefore immobilize more capital per identity and risk losing it. The ledge, nectar, and jetty can name challenge rounds, rewards, and checkpoints without changing the rule.
